📈 Problem A: Modal Price Estimation (3 Regression Algorithms)
Target: Modal_Price (₹/Quintal) | Inputs: State, District, APMC Market, Commodity, Variety, Grade (Zero Price Leakage)
Target: Modal_Price
Methodology & Leakage Prevention: Min_Price and Max_Price are strictly excluded from inputs to ensure models learn genuine market-commodity spatial economics. Evaluated on 3,347 held-out test records (20% split).
Algorithm Train MAE Test MAE Test MSE Test RMSE Train R² Test R² Status
🎯 Problem B: Commodity Price Tier Classification (3 Classification Algorithms)
Target: Price_Tier (Budget <₹3k | Standard ₹3k-₹10k | Premium >₹10k) | Inputs: Market & Commodity Descriptors
Target: Price_Tier
Model Architecture Note: Logistic Regression with L2 regularization is the overall top classifier (84.67%). Multinomial Naive Bayes achieves 80.97% accuracy on One-Hot Encoded binary indicators using Laplace smoothing, comfortably exceeding the majority class baseline (60.71%).

⚠️ Project Limitations & Dataset Scope
Methodological Notice

1. Cross-Sectional Snapshot: The dataset is an audited cross-sectional snapshot representing daily prices on October 29, 2026 from Data.gov.in (Agmarknet). It does not contain longitudinal time-series data or seasonal price trends.

2. Arrival Volumes Unrecorded: Daily arrival quantities (in metric tonnes) are absent in the raw feed, precluding elastic supply-demand price modelling.

3. Data Leakage Prevention: Min_Price and Max_Price were intentionally omitted from input features to prevent trivial mathematical envelope interpolation.
